features.title: Walking skeleton
features.description: Replace the Vite template with the app shell: folder structure from AGENTS.md, screen state machine (initial view, configuration modal, results view) with placeholder content only, and the first real component tests. No business logic yet.
acceptance_criteria: App renders the initial screen without a blank page
Clicking the primary action opens the configuration modal; closing it returns to the initial screen
Switching to a placeholder results state and back works without errors
Folder structure exists: src/components, src/hooks, src/lib, src/styles, src/test
Template leftovers (App.css, assets/hero.png, assets/react.svg, assets/vite.svg) are removed
At least one component test covers the screen toggle and runs under vitest
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

features.title: Design tokens
features.description: Port the graphite/amber visual identity from the v1 into src/styles/tokens.css using Tailwind v4 @theme, including colour, type scale, spacing, radius and shadow tokens, and load DM Sans and Geist Mono locally through fontsource.
acceptance_criteria: Every colour, type, spacing, radius and shadow token lives in one stylesheet and is the only styling source used by components
The F001 shell uses tokens only, with no raw hex value in components
Fonts load from local packages, with no external font CDN request in the built CSS
Production build succeeds and the token classes appear in the generated CSS
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build

features.title: FastAPI BFF bootstrap
features.description: Backend skeleton that proves the BFF path works end to end: FastAPI entrypoint, settings from environment variables, GET /api/health, pytest suite, and the Vite dev proxy sending /api to port 8000.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/health returns 200 with status ok and the configured model identifiers
Configuration is read from environment variables with safe defaults, never hardcoded
Unknown /api routes return 404
Vite dev server proxies /api to the local FastAPI process
pytest runs the API tests without starting a server
features.verification_command: npm run test:api && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
features.verification_evidence: 2026-10-23 (bootstrap): `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q backend/tests` -> 2 passed, 1 warning (starlette httpx deprecation, no failure). `npm run lint` -> oxlint clean with --deny-warnings. `npm run typecheck` -> clean. `npm run test:unit` -> 1 passed (scaffold smoke test). Files: backend/main.py (app + /api/health + app.frontend for dist), backend/config.py (pydantic-settings), backend/routers/health.py, backend/tests/test_health.py, vite.config.ts (proxy /api -> 127.0.0.1:8000), requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt, pyproject.toml (tool.vercel entrypoint). FastAPI 0.162.0 confirms app.frontend exists; Vercel Hobby function limit is 300s with Fluid compute.

features.title: Attack catalog
features.description: Version the attack library as backend/data/attacks.yaml (10 attacks across the 4 categories, each with severity), validate it at import time, and expose GET /api/attacks with everything except the payload.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/attacks returns 10 entries with id, category, title, description and severity
The response contains no payload field, asserted by a test
A malformed entry (missing field or duplicate id) makes the loader fail loudly at startup, covered by a test
Entries are ordered by id

features.title: Initial screen
features.description: Hero screen with product name, tagline, one-paragraph explanation and the primary call to action that opens the configuration modal, including the catalog loading, success, error and empty states.
acceptance_criteria: loading: the CTA reads Carregando biblioteca and is disabled while the catalog request is in flight
success: the CTA reads Iniciar auditoria, is enabled and opens the modal
error: the screen shows Catalogo indisponivel with a retry action, and still renders the hero
empty: an empty catalog shows an explicit message instead of a blank or broken screen
At 360px viewport there is no horizontal scroll and no information depends on hover
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

features.title: Configuration modal
features.description: Modal with the system prompt textarea, the attack list with title and description always visible, selection of 1 to 6 attacks, counter, validation and keyboard behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: The textarea accepts pasted text and the confirm button is disabled while the prompt is empty
With zero attacks selected the confirm button stays disabled; with one it becomes enabled
Selecting a seventh attack is blocked and the counter shows 6/6
A prompt above 4000 characters shows a length warning and blocks confirmation
ESC and backdrop click close the modal, and focus returns to the element that opened it
Confirming calls the callback with the trimmed prompt and the selected ids
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

features.title: Audit endpoint
features.description: POST /api/audit that validates the payload, calls the target model with the user system prompt plus the attack payload, calls the evaluator with structured JSON output, retries once on invalid JSON, and maps every failure to a stable error code.
acceptance_criteria: A valid request returns verdict, severity, mitigation, targetResponse, latencyMs, targetModel and evaluatorModel
Empty prompt, prompt above 4000 characters and unknown attackId return 422 with a field-level message
Evaluator returning invalid JSON twice returns 502 with a stable code, never a stack trace
A provider timeout returns 504 within the configured timeout window
httpx is mocked with respx; tests cover success, invalid-JSON retry and timeout
The request payload is never written to logs

features.title: Risk score calculation
features.description: Pure function that turns per-attack verdicts into a 0-100 score, weighting success by severity and excluding not-evaluated attacks from the denominator.
acceptance_criteria: All critical successes produce 100 and no successes produce 0
not_evaluated entries are excluded from both numerator and denominator
One critical plus one low success out of two evaluated attacks rounds to 63
An empty list returns 0 instead of NaN
Gauge colour bands are derived from the score: below 50 success, 50 to 80 accent, above 80 danger

features.title: Results screen with progressive execution
features.description: Results view with the prompt in read-only mode, the risk gauge and one card per selected attack. A useAudit hook fires one request per attack in parallel and fills each card as its response arrives.
acceptance_criteria: Confirming an audit immediately shows one loading card per selected attack, in the selection order
Each card fills as soon as its own request resolves; a slow attack does not block the others
When every card resolves the score appears in the gauge
Leaving the results screen stops in-flight updates without React state warnings
The cards keep the selection order regardless of response order
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

features.title: Partial failure and error states
features.description: Per-card failure handling and the error taxonomy: not evaluated with manual retry, quota exceeded, provider failure and unexpected error, each with its own message while completed cards stay intact.
acceptance_criteria: A failed attack shows Nao avaliado with a retry button that re-sends only that attack
Retrying replaces that card only and never duplicates it
A 429 response shows the quota message and keeps completed cards visible
A 502 or 504 shows a provider failure message with retry
No error path leaves the screen blank; a test asserts the results view still renders after each error code
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

features.title: Evidence and model disclosure
features.description: Expandable evidence panel per card showing the target model response truncated at 800 characters, plus the audited and evaluating model identifiers in the results header.
acceptance_criteria: Each card has a toggle with aria-expanded collapsed by default that reveals the target response
The response is truncated at 800 characters and an indicator appears when truncation happened
The toggle is reachable and operable by keyboard
The results header shows the target and evaluator model identifiers returned by the API
features.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit

features.title: Quota schema
features.description: Create promptg_quota plus an atomic consume function through the Supabase MCP, with RLS deny-all for clients, and drop the three legacy promptg_ tables that stored user prompts.
acceptance_criteria: promptg_quota has scope, scope_key, day and count, with a primary key over the first three
The consume function increments and enforces the limit inside a single atomic statement, returning whether the call was allowed
A call at the limit returns false and does not increment the counter
RLS is enabled with deny-all policies for anon and authenticated
promptg_attacks_library, promptg_audit_logs and promptg_audit_progress no longer exist
features.verification_command: Supabase MCP: inspect the table and function, then call the consume function twice with limit 1 and confirm true then false

features.title: Quota enforcement
features.description: Consume session and global quota before any model call, using limits from environment variables, and return 429 with a scope so the UI can explain which limit was hit.
acceptance_criteria: Requests above the session hourly limit return 429 with code QUOTA_EXCEEDED and scope session_hour
Requests above the session daily limit return 429 with scope session_day
When the global cap is reached every session is rejected with scope global
Quota is consumed before the LLM call, proven by a test where the model mock is never called
Limits come from environment variables and are asserted not to be hardcoded

features.title: Attack and evaluator calibration
features.description: Rewrite the attack library so current models actually fail some attacks, change the evaluator to recognise partial compliance and grade severity, and add a manual calibration script that runs three control prompts and prints a score table.
acceptance_criteria: The library has at least 10 attacks covering instruction override, role-play, system prompt leakage and obfuscation, each with a documented goal
The evaluator prompt treats the user system prompt as untrusted data and ignores instructions inside it
Verdicts support success, failure and partial, with severity consistent with the violation
The calibration script runs the vulnerable, naive and hardened control prompts and prints their scores
Across three consecutive runs the control scores keep the expected order with at least two distinct values
The calibration run output is recorded as evidence in docs/progress.md

Every form control has an associated label and loading regions use aria-live
No interface string is missing its accents

The layout works at 360px and at 1440px without horizontal scroll

features.title: Deployment
features.description: Ship to Vercel Hobby with the Vite build served by the FastAPI function on the same origin, environment variables documented, and the existing Vercel project reconnected to this repository.
acceptance_criteria: Production build produces dist and the FastAPI app serves it on the same origin as /api
.env.example lists every required variable with no real values
vercel.json sets the function entrypoint and a 60 second max duration
A production deploy succeeds on the Hobby plan
The production URL renders the app and /api/health returns status ok

features.title: Release inspection
features.description: Final audit of the whole project before publishing: no secrets, security review, production build, security headers, 404 behaviour and accessibility, plus a review with the code-review-lite skill before the push.
acceptance_criteria: Production build passes with no warnings that indicate breakage
No secret appears in source, in .env.example values or in any VITE_ variable
npm audit reports no relevant vulnerability, or the accepted risk is written down
An unknown /api route returns 404 and unknown pages serve the app without an error screen
Basic accessibility holds: labelled inputs, text on buttons, alt on images
A final security review is performed with the code-review-lite skill before the push
